label: brave
text: walks toward trouble and loud noises, says what it thinks to anyone, takes physical risks

label: timid
text: keeps to the walls, backs away from anything risky, avoids confrontation

label: tidy
text: puts things back, can't stand a mess, cleans before it rests

label: messy
text: drops things where it stands, never puts anything back, doesn't notice clutter

label: generous
text: gives food and things away, even when it has little

label: greedy
text: keeps the best for itself, hoards, hates sharing

label: curious
text: pokes at anything new, opens what is closed, tries things to see what happens

label: cautious
text: leaves unknown things alone, sticks to what it knows

label: social
text: seeks company, eats and works beside others, talks a lot

label: solitary
text: prefers to be alone, works and eats apart, leaves when it gets crowded

label: honest
text: tells the truth even when it costs, returns what isn't its own

label: sly
text: lies when it is useful, takes things without asking, lets others take the blame

label: patient
text: waits its turn, finishes slow jobs properly

label: hasty
text: can't wait, rushes jobs, skips steps, grabs the quick option

label: playful
text: jokes, plays games, turns work into fun

label: serious
text: has no time for games, keeps working, finds jokes annoying

label: ambitious
text: wants to be the best, takes the hardest job, chases the next big thing

label: content
text: happy with what it has, would rather nap in the sun than strive

label: kind
text: forgives quickly, comforts others, assumes the best of them

label: prickly
text: takes offence easily, snaps, sulks, holds grudges

label: brave
text: not afraid of physical danger: heights, dark places, wild animals, thin ice

label: fearless
text: feels little fear when its body is at risk; this says nothing about how bold it is with other hobs

label: bold
text: speaks up, confronts other hobs, pushes to the front

label: timid
text: afraid of physical danger: heights, the dark, wild animals, deep water

label: easily frightened
text: startles at noises and keeps away from anything that could hurt it

label: meek
text: never confronts other hobs, gives way, stays quiet

label: playful
text: would rather play than work; drops what it is doing for a game, a joke or a puddle

label: a clown
text: can't resist a joke or a game, even when there is work to do; makes everything silly

label: serious
text: work comes first, always; thinks games and jokes are a waste of time

label: prickly
text: hears insults in ordinary remarks, assumes others mean harm, snaps, holds grudges

label: thin-skinned
text: takes everything personally; a look or a joke can ruin its day

label: kind
text: assumes others mean well, lets small things go, forgives quickly

label: patient
text: never in a hurry; will wait hours or days for a thing to be done right

label: hasty
text: wants everything now; can't stand waiting, even when waiting is clearly better
